ability.shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
ability.shield_bash.desc: Slams the selected enemy at close range.
ability.battle_rally.name: Battle Rally
ability.heroic_strike.name: Heroic Strike
ability.heroic_strike.desc: A crushing blow with very short reach.
ability.rampage.name: Rampage
ability.arc_bolt.name: Arc Bolt
ability.arc_bolt.desc: Homing bolt toward a selected enemy.
ability.mana_surge.name: Mana Surge
ability.mana_surge.desc: Restores mana instantly; no target required.
ability.frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
ability.frost_lance.desc: Piercing shard with strong impact damage.
ability.pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
ability.pyroblast.desc: Massive fireball with the longest reach in the mage kit.
ability.quick_shot.name: Quick Shot
ability.quick_shot.desc: Very fast arrow with modest damage.
ability.field_dressing.name: Field Dressing
ability.piercing_arrow.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.longshot.name: Longshot
ability.longshot.desc: Sniper shot across the longest range of any kit.
ability.smite.name: Smite
ability.smite.desc: Radiant bolt against a selected enemy.
ability.renew.name: Renew
ability.divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
ability.guardians_blessing.name: Guardian's Blessing
ability.guardians_blessing.desc: Major self-restoration; the strongest heal in the game.
ability.feral_swipe.name: Feral Swipe
ability.feral_swipe.desc: Rakes the selected enemy at close range.
ability.barkskin.name: Barkskin
ability.barkskin.desc: Hardens like old wood and mends wounds between camps.
ability.hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
ability.hunters_mark.desc: Thrown spear that pins prey at medium range.
ability.primal_maul.name: Primal Maul
ability.primal_maul.desc: Savage finisher for monsters and heroes caught out of lane.
ability.dawn_bind.name: Gleaming Snare
ability.dawn_bind.desc: Aimed light binds the first two enemies it hits.
ability.dawn_barrier.name: Returning Aegis
ability.dawn_barrier.desc: A returning light shields allies on both journeys.
ability.dawn_field.name: Luminous Field
ability.dawn_field.desc: Place a slowing field; cast again to detonate it.
ability.dawn_ray.name: Horizon Ray
ability.dawn_ray.desc: A warned beam detonates Radiance marks and applies them again.
ability.wild_switch.name: Switchfire
ability.wild_switch.desc: Toggle rapid repeater fire and longer-range rockets that spend Mana.
ability.wild_zap.name: Shockline
ability.wild_zap.desc: Aimed shot slows and reveals the first enemy hit.
ability.wild_traps.name: Snapline
ability.wild_traps.desc: Place three traps that arm, then root enemy heroes.
ability.wild_rocket.name: Last Spark
ability.wild_rocket.desc: A long-range rocket explodes on a hero, punishing wounded enemies.
ability.fault_line.name: Fault Line
ability.fault_line.desc: Fracture the ground; a delayed solid pillar rises at the endpoint.
ability.furnace_breath.name: Furnace Breath
ability.furnace_breath.desc: Breathe fire while resisting displacement; the final blast applies Brittle.
ability.anvil_charge.name: Anvil Charge
ability.anvil_charge.desc: Charge forward; terrain impact knocks up nearby enemies.
ability.mountain_echo.name: Mountain Echo
ability.mountain_echo.desc: Call an incoming colossus; recast nearby to redirect it and knock enemies up.
ability.edge_lunge.name: Edge Lunge
ability.edge_lunge.desc: Lunge and strike the nearest enemy; a hit refunds part of the cooldown.
ability.mirror_guard.name: Mirror Guard
ability.mirror_guard.desc: Parry damage and control, then counterattack; blocked immobilization empowers the counter.
ability.twin_tempo.name: Twin Tempo
ability.twin_tempo.desc: Empower two attacks: the first slows, the second deals critical damage.
ability.fourfold_duel.name: Fourfold Duel
ability.fourfold_duel.desc: Expose four directional vitals; complete the challenge to create an allied healing field.
ability.echo_strike.name: Echo Strike
ability.echo_strike.desc: Mark the first enemy hit; recast to dash to that exact target.
ability.anchor_step.name: Anchor Step
ability.anchor_step.desc: Leap to an ally or place a short-lived anchor; recast for lifesteal.
ability.thunder_pulse.name: Thunder Pulse
ability.thunder_pulse.desc: Damage and reveal nearby enemies; recast to slow those victims.
ability.thunder_kick.name: Thunder Kick
ability.thunder_kick.desc: Kick an enemy away, damaging and lifting other enemies along its path.
ability.thorn_volley.name: Thorn Volley
ability.thorn_volley.desc: Launch a marking spike followed by up to three priority-target recasts.
ability.patient_curse.name: Patient Curse
ability.patient_curse.desc: Curse a visible target; let the mark mature before hitting to charm and weaken it.
ability.shadow_lash.name: Shadow Lash
ability.shadow_lash.desc: Whip a nearby target and gain speed; shroud empowers the approach.
ability.nightfall.name: Nightfall
ability.nightfall.desc: Strike a frontal area, execute wounded enemies and retreat while briefly untargetable.
ability.wandering_ember.name: Wandering Ember
ability.wandering_ember.desc: Send an orb out and back to your moving position; the return deals true damage.
ability.kindled_wisps.name: Kindled Wisps
ability.kindled_wisps.desc: Gain speed and launch three guided flames at nearby enemies.
ability.heart_tether.name: Heart Tether
ability.heart_tether.desc: The first enemy hit walks helplessly toward you.
ability.flame_dance.name: Flame Dance
ability.flame_dance.desc: Dash and fire guided bolts; up to three casts, with a bounded takedown refund.
ability.orbital_command.name: Orbital Command
ability.orbital_command.desc: Move your persistent orb, damaging enemies along its path.
ability.orbital_field.name: Orbital Field
ability.orbital_field.desc: At the orb, burst damage and create a field that hastens allies and slows enemies.
ability.orbital_guard.name: Orbital Guard
ability.orbital_guard.desc: Send the orb to an ally, damaging the path and granting a shield and defensive aura.
ability.orbital_collapse.name: Orbital Collapse
ability.orbital_collapse.desc: After a visible delay, the orb damages and pulls nearby enemies inward.
ability.rift_needle.name: Rift Needle
ability.rift_needle.desc: First-hit shot applies attack effects and reduces your active cooldowns on hit.
ability.rift_seal.name: Rift Seal
ability.rift_seal.desc: Mark the first hero or structure; only your own attack or spell can detonate it.
ability.rift_step.name: Rift Step
ability.rift_step.desc: Blink to a legal location and fire at a nearby enemy, prioritizing your seal.
ability.horizon_wave.name: Horizon Wave
ability.horizon_wave.desc: Wind up a piercing arena-range wave; non-heroes take reduced damage.
ability.iron_hook.name: Iron Hook
ability.iron_hook.desc: Catch and hold the first enemy, then recast to approach the hooked target.
ability.guiding_lantern.name: Guiding Lantern
ability.guiding_lantern.desc: Place a shielding lantern; a nearby ally can explicitly interact to travel to you.
ability.chain_sweep.name: Chain Sweep
ability.chain_sweep.desc: Sweep enemies in your aimed direction; attacks charge while you wait.
ability.iron_boundary.name: Iron Boundary
ability.iron_boundary.desc: Raise five boundary segments; each breaks on enemy contact and slows its victim.
ability.winter_shard.name: Winter Shard
ability.winter_shard.desc: Slow the first enemy and apply Concussion; allied attacks complete the stun.
ability.sheltering_leap.name: Sheltering Leap
ability.sheltering_leap.desc: Leap to an allied hero or minion; protect yourself and the ally.
ability.northwall.name: Northwall
ability.northwall.desc: Intercept incoming frontal projectiles: negate the first and reduce later hits.
ability.winter_divide.name: Winter Divide
ability.winter_divide.desc: Raise a fissure that knocks up enemies and leaves a slowing trail.
